description.value: Lighthouse Cake Company is a family-owned bakery in the Goldstream area of Greater Victoria, specializing in custom cakes and a rotating selection of pastries made with high-quality ingredients by Red Seal certified bakers. Originally founded in 1998 as Lighthouse Bakery, it was featured on Food Network Canada's 'Project Bakeover' (Episode 5). Gluten-free and egg-free versions of most standard cakes are available by advance order.
